ink.$description: Base ink swatch, same value as ink-900. Reserved for the GOAL part of the wordmark and dark canvas.

ink-900.$description: Darkest ink. Default canvas in the dark (default) theme.

ink-800.$description: Default surface in the dark theme.

ink-700.$description: Elevated surface in the dark theme.

ink-600.$description: Hairline border in the dark theme.

paper.$description: Pure white. Canvas in the light theme, text-on-signal.

paper-50.$description: Off-white. Default text on ink (dark theme).

line.$description: Hairline border in the light theme.

signal.$description: Unique brand accent. No secondary accent color exists. Non-text usage: gauge, halo, live dot, wordmark 'live'.

signal-deep.$description: Signal variant used behind white text (buttons, CTAs).

signal-hover.$description: Hover state of signal (non signal-deep usages, e.g. ghost border).

canvas-dark.$description: Theme alias source — canvas, dark (default) theme. Same as ink-900.

canvas-light.$description: Theme alias source — canvas, light theme. Same as paper.

surface-dark.$description: Theme alias source — surface, dark (default) theme. Same as ink-800.

surface-light.$description: Theme alias source — surface, light theme. Same as paper-50.

surface-elevated-dark.$description: Theme alias source — elevated surface, dark (default) theme. Same as ink-700.

surface-elevated-light.$description: Theme alias source — elevated surface, light theme. Same as paper.

text-dark.$description: Theme alias source — text, dark (default) theme. Same as paper-50.

text-light.$description: Theme alias source — text, light theme. Same as ink-900.

text-muted-dark.$description: Theme alias source — muted text, dark (default) theme. Same as grey-400.

text-muted-light.$description: Theme alias source — muted text, light theme. Same as grey-600.

hairline-dark.$description: Theme alias source — hairline, dark (default) theme. Same as ink-600.

hairline-light.$description: Theme alias source — hairline, light theme. Same as line.
